segments.text: At the beginning, we are using Copilot Studio because it's easy to create your first agent. Each day, we are creating more complex agents with Copilot Studio.
Especially with the Business Central MCB server, the solution is now in one hotel, but we want to create a reusable solution.

With Copilot Studio, it's very easy. >> We strongly believe that Business Central is the best technology product out in the market. And we, as a payroll solution, adopt all that technology on top of Business Central.
We see that smaller businesses outsource their payroll because of the complexity. With Agent and Copilot, we can help smaller companies to in-house payroll again.

>> The biggest wins with the payroll agent is that it automates a lot of those tasks that rely on manual data entry. Using the toolkit from Microsoft and all of the Copilot capabilities, along with the new custom agents that we can build, forms an epic package no other competitors in the market really have outside of the Microsoft platform.

>> Aptn is an AI-first company. We have a lot of other ERP systems and operational solutions in our portfolio, but Business Central is our main driver because we can build on top of this with our vertical industry solutions.

Often, you see customers who are playing around with AI in their private life, but have not really seen what is the business value, what's the impact on their own companies when they would implement AI.

And what we bring is the industry-specific agents from Business Central, for example, our manifest purchase order creation agent or the sales claim agent. And this is really what they can see, ah, this is why we should use AI.

>> Our agents are completely reusable. It's for every customer, for every partner. It's not a black box. We are based normally in Business Central, so we try to develop the most of them in Business Central.
On top of that, we're using also Copilot Chat. It's completely changing how we develop it towards back-driven development. >> My biggest recommendation to any partner,
start as soon as possible. Make a small step forward. >> Don't try to solve all the problems. Try to solve one problem, one issue.
>> Bringing preconfigured agent with specific industry needs, that's what brings us the best opportunities for the future.
